name: Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor
summary: The Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor is a confidential report penned by Warden Thelwater regarding an enigmatic man who visited the imprisoned Defias leader, Bazil Thredd, inside the Stormwind Stockade. Its contents help track down a covert operative moving unseen through Stormwind's political and criminal spheres.

sections.title: A Mysterious Patron
sections.body: For years inside the Stockade, prisoner Bazil Thredd sat in his cell with no visitors. That routine shifted when an uncommunicative man began stopping by once or twice a week with completely valid identification papers. Taking note of these unusual arrivals, Warden Thelwater composed a physical account of the man, who carried identification marking him as 'Maelik'. The warden sealed the profile to prevent any meddling eyes from reading it before proper investigators could act.

sections.title: From Stonemasons to Spies
sections.body: When brought to the city architect Baros Alexston, the description sparked no immediate recognition beyond a faint suspicion that the visitor might be an operative tied to the Defias rebellion. Alexston quickly rerouted the sealed envelope to Master Mathias Shaw, leader of Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7. Shaw immediately pierced the deception: the description matched a lethal mercenary who operates under aliases including Marzon, currently doing dirty work for Lord Gregor Lescovar.

faq.answer: Warden Thelwater, the head warden of the Stormwind Stockade, wrote and sealed the document. He grew suspicious when an unknown figure began paying regular visits to the imprisoned Defias ringleader, Bazil Thredd.

faq.q: Who is the visitor described in the paper?
faq.answer: He presented papers under the name Maelik. Warden Thelwater recorded his appearance so investigators could establish his identity.

faq.q: Why was the visitor meeting with Bazil Thredd?
faq.answer: Thelwater grew suspicious when Thredd began receiving regular visits after years without any. The visitor's purpose is investigated through the sealed description.

faq.q: Where does this sealed document need to be taken?
faq.answer: The document is first brought to the city architect Baros Alexston in Stormwind. After Alexston examines it and finds the description unfamiliar, he directs you to deliver it directly to Master Mathias Shaw at the SI:7 headquarters in Old Town.

angles.text: Carrying this dossier is a direct lesson in tradecraft: false names, forged documentation, and cell visits are all uncovered when Mathias Shaw cross-references physical descriptions against SI:7 intelligence.
The document exposes troubling cracks in Stormwind's internal security, proving that conspirators can walk straight through the Stockade's gates using falsified credentials.
